records.semanticMeaning: Supply-chain-intensive manufacturing and investment networks are supported as functioning carriers of current regional economic activity.
records.exactMechanism: Regional manufacturing/investment activity is organized through supply-chain-intensive industries that carry production and capital relationships.
records.whySupported: Direct investment-report evidence identifies supply-chain-intensive industries as material drivers of current ASEAN investment growth.
doesNotEstablish: Future dominance of ASEAN supply chains
records.competingInterpretation: The evidence may reflect cyclical investment concentration rather than durable carrier continuity.
unresolvedEvidence: Longitudinal persistence across multiple reporting periods and sectors.

records.semanticMeaning: Regional production, investment, supply-chain and connectivity relationships are supported as an ongoing organized runtime rather than a merely planned formation.
records.exactMechanism: Existing cross-border production and investment relationships operate while infrastructure coordination routes energy and economic flows.
records.whySupported: The evidence jointly shows current production/investment operation, existing supply-chain carriers and active cross-border infrastructure coordination.
records.competingInterpretation: Some connectivity components remain in build-out and may be better treated as activation rather than mature runtime.
unresolvedEvidence: Member-state-specific runtime maturity and cross-border throughput for every infrastructure corridor.

records.semanticMeaning: External fuel dependence and concentrated supply routes are supported as active constraints on the current regional energy-economic runtime.
records.exactMechanism: Imported fuel exposure transmits external supply shocks into energy cost, inflation, operational flexibility and fiscal support requirements.
records.whySupported: IEA evidence directly identifies import dependence, route concentration and current shock transmission into regional operation.
doesNotEstablish: Uniform vulnerability across all member states
records.competingInterpretation: Some member states possess domestic resources or alternative supply structures that reduce the regional aggregate constraint.
unresolvedEvidence: Country-level exposure weights and persistence after the 2026 shock.

blocked.reason: DEFA negotiation conclusion does not establish mature current carrier operation.

boundary: W8-F candidates are reviewable semantic derivations, not accepted runtime positions. Only EVIDENCE_READY W8-E records advance.
